Before we begin

Materials that fit the setting

Sun, moisture, storage and cleaning needs all influence the most practical fabric, vinyl, foam and construction choices.

Common questions

Planning an outdoor project

Can you reuse the existing outdoor foam?

Sometimes. We assess its shape, support, condition and exposure before recommending whether it should be reused or replaced.

What materials are suitable for outdoor seating?

The best choice depends on sun, moisture, storage and frequency of use. We can discuss outdoor-rated fabrics or vinyls suited to the project.

Do you make replacement cushion covers?

Yes, fitted replacement covers may be possible when the existing cushions or accurate dimensions are available for patterning.

Do you work on boat seating?

We accept selected boat seating and interior marine pieces. Photos help us confirm the shape, construction, access and materials required.
